observations: Photo 0 shows a white and beige sewing machine on a speckled countertop. The machine has a handwheel on the right, a foot pedal, and a needle area. The surface shows some dust and minor wear.

Photo 1 shows the same machine from a slightly different angle. The brand name 'SYNCHOM' is visible on the front panel. A serial number '543210' is visible on the top surface. The machine appears to be an industrial or vintage model, with a large handwheel and a foot pedal.
The machine has a beige base and a white top casing. The needle area is visible with a metal needle and presser foot. The foot pedal is connected by a cable.
There is no visible power cord or motor in either photo. The machine appears to be a standalone unit, possibly a treadle or hand-crank model, but no motor is clearly visible.

claims.claim: A solid New Home vintage sewing machine available for sale.
claims.evidence: The machine appears to be a vintage model, but 'solid New Home' is not verifiable from the photos. The term 'solid' is subjective and not visually confirmed.

claims.claim: This is more than a basic...
claims.evidence: The seller's text is cut off. The claim about 'more than a basic' cannot be verified from the photos or text alone.

claims.claim: Japanese made, the motor runs smooth. All accessories and the original manual, never serviced because nothing ever went wrong.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The machine may not be functional or may have internal damage not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine in operation, including the needle moving and the motor running if applicable.

risks.risk: The machine may be missing essential parts such as the power cord, motor, or foot pedal assembly.
risks.proof: A photo showing the full machine with all components, including the power cord and motor if present.

risks.risk: The machine may have hidden wear or damage to the needle, presser foot, or internal mechanisms.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the needle, presser foot, and internal mechanism (if accessible) under good lighting.

proof_requests: Close-up of the sticker with the model number, usually inside the door or on the inside of the hood.
Video of the machine in operation, showing the needle moving and any motor running.
Photo showing the full machine with all components, including power cord and motor if applicable.
Close-up photos of the needle, presser foot, and internal mechanism under good lighting.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
